commands.query: SELECT table_name,column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public'AND table_name IN('data_sources','sync_logs','knowledge_bases','tenants','models','tenant_portal_configs','users','system_settings','embeddings','feishu_legacy_resources','feishu_legacy_attempts')
SELECT extname,extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname IN('vector','pg_search')
SELECT count(*)AS accounts,count(*)FILTER(WHERE is_active)AS active_accounts FROM users

SELECT count(DISTINCT t.id)AS published_active_spaces,count(DISTINCT kb.id)AS live_KBs,count(DISTINCT kb.id)FILTER(WHERE kb.type='document')AS document_KBs,count(DISTINCT kb.id)FILTER(WHERE kb.type='document'AND NOT COALESCE(kb.is_temporary,false))AS non_temporary_document_KBs FROM tenant_portal_configs pc JOIN tenants t ON t.id=pc.tenant_id JOIN knowledge_bases kb ON kb.tenant_id=t.id WHERE pc.status='published'AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status='active'AND kb.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT substr(md5('knowhub-b7-space:'||t.id::text),1,16)AS space_ref,substr(md5('knowhub-b7-kb:'||kb.id),1,16)AS kb_ref,kb.type,kb.is_temporary,kb.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AS kb_deleted,t.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AS space_deleted,t.status AS space_status,pc.status AS portal_status,(SELECT count(*)FROM knowledges k WHERE k.knowledge_base_id=kb.id AND k.tenant_id=kb.tenant_id AND k.deleted_at IS NULL)AS documents FROM tenant_portal_configs pc JOIN tenants t ON t.id=pc.tenant_id JOIN knowledge_bases kb ON kb.tenant_id=t.id

SELECT substr(md5(id),1,16)AS model_ref,type,source,status,is_default,parameters::jsonb->'embedding_parameters'->>'dimension'AS dimension,COALESCE(parameters::jsonb->>'api_key','')<>''AS credential_present,COALESCE(parameters::jsonb->>'base_url','')<>''AS endpoint_present FROM models WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT substr(md5('knowhub-b7-kb:'||kb.id),1,16)AS kb_ref,substr(md5(kb.embedding_model_id),1,16)AS model_ref,m.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AS model_deleted,m.status AS model_status,m.parameters::jsonb->'embedding_parameters'->>'dimension'AS dimension FROM tenant_portal_configs pc JOIN tenants t ON t.id=pc.tenant_id JOIN knowledge_bases kb ON kb.tenant_id=t.id LEFT JOIN models m ON m.id=kb.embedding_model_id WHERE pc.status='published'AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status='active'AND kb.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT dimension,count(*)AS rows FROM embeddings GROUP BY dimension
SELECT indexname,substring(indexdef from 'halfvec\(([0-9]+)\)')AS halfvec_dimension FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public'AND tablename='embeddings'AND indexdef ILIKE '%hnsw%'

SELECT substr(md5('knowhub-formal-source:'||id),1,16)AS source_ref,type,status,sync_mode,sync_deletions,last_sync_at,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(now()-last_sync_at))/3600 AS hours_since_sync,deleted_at IS NOT NULL AS deleted,COALESCE(error_message,'')<>''AS has_error,last_sync_cursor IS NOT NULL AS has_cursor,md5(COALESCE(last_sync_cursor::text,''))AS cursor_fingerprint,'SCHEMA_UNAVAILABLE'::text AS legacy_access_state FROM data_sources WHERE type IN('feishu','feishu_drive')

SELECT substr(md5('knowhub-formal-source:'||l.data_source_id),1,16)AS source_ref,l.status,count(*)AS rows FROM sync_logs l JOIN data_sources d ON d.id=l.data_source_id WHERE d.type IN('feishu','feishu_drive')GROUP BY l.data_source_id,l.status
SELECT key,value FROM system_settings WHERE key IN('auth.oidc.enabled','auth.sourceid.enabled','feishu.legacy_sync_suspended','feishu.safe_incremental_enabled')AND COALESCE(is_secret,false)=false

safe_directives: proxy_set_header Connection ""; # 禁用 Connection: close，保持连接打开
proxy_read_timeout 3600s;                  # 增加读取超时时间
proxy_send_timeout 3600s;                  # 增加发送超时时间
